social.title: Palio di Siena
social.description: Cram into Piazza del Campo for the bareback horse race that splits Siena into 17 rival neighbourhoods.
social.bonus: Pick a contrada, buy its scarf and cheer for it all day.

social.title: Aperitivo on Piazza Santo Spirito
social.description: Join the Oltrarno crowd sprawled on the church steps of Florence's liveliest square at golden hour.
social.bonus: Sit on the church steps and strike up a conversation with whoever is next to you.

social.title: Cheese and Wine at Il Santino
social.description: Squeeze into the tiny Oltrarno wine bar for natural pours and Tuscan cheeses at the counter.
social.bonus: Spill out onto the street with your glass like the regulars.

social.title: Rooftop Drinks at SE-STO on Arno
social.description: Sip sunset cocktails in a glass rooftop atop the Westin Excelsior with a 360 view of Florence.
social.bonus: Make a toast to the dome, face the dome.

social.title: Wine by the Glass at Cantinetta Antinori
social.description: Drink the Antinori family's wines inside their 15th-century palazzo, where they've poured since 1957.
social.bonus: Order the same grape from two different Antinori estates and compare.

social.title: Tasting Menu at Pitti Gola e Cantina
social.description: Snag a terrace table facing Palazzo Pitti for small-producer wines and a paired tasting.
social.bonus: Let the owners pick every pour.

social.title: ACF Fiorentina Match at Stadio Artemio Franchi
social.description: Wear purple and join the Viola faithful for Serie A at Florence's modernist stadium.
social.bonus: Learn the Curva Fiesole chant before kickoff.

social.title: Truffle Panini and Prosecco at Procacci
social.description: Clink glasses over tiny truffle sandwiches at the Tornabuoni deli serving them since 1885.
social.bonus: Order three different panini and rank them.

social.title: Wine Bar Crawl Start at Le Volpi e l'Uva
social.description: Stand at the counter of this tiny Oltrarno wine bar near Ponte Vecchio for small-producer pours and crostini.
social.bonus: Ask for a wine from a producer you have never heard of.

social.title: Chianti Tasting at Castello di Verrazzano
social.description: Tour the cellars of the hilltop castle above Greve and taste Chianti Classico and Vin Santo with friends.
social.bonus: Toast the explorer Giovanni da Verrazzano, born in this castle.

social.title: Ring the Wine Window at Babae
social.description: Ring the bell at a revived Renaissance buchetta del vino and get a glass of red passed through the wall.
social.bonus: Ring the bell and order in Italian.

social.title: Calcio Storico Fiorentino in Piazza Santa Croce
social.description: Watch Florence's brutal Renaissance football, fought in sand on Piazza Santa Croce by four city quarters.
social.bonus: Pick a team colour and wear it.

chill.title: Gregorian Vespers at San Miniato al Monte
chill.description: Hear the Olivetan monks chant vespers in Florence's most beautiful Romanesque church high above the city.
chill.bonus: Stay seated until the very last note fades.

chill.title: Slow Stroll Through the Orto Botanico di Siena
chill.description: Wander the terraced university botanical garden tucked inside Siena's walls, with open views over the valley.
chill.bonus: Find a bench facing the Val di Montone and stay put for one full song.

chill.title: View from San Francesco Monastery in Fiesole
chill.description: Walk the steep lane to Fiesole's hilltop friary for the classic sweep of Florence below.
chill.bonus: Read a page of something on the bench at the belvedere halfway up.

chill.title: Coffee in Lucca's Piazza dell'Anfiteatro
chill.description: Sit in the oval piazza built on the footprint of a Roman amphitheatre.
chill.bonus: Walk the full oval and count the arch entrances.

chill.title: Morning Coffee at Caffe Gilli
chill.description: Sip a cappuccino at the Belle Epoque bar of Florence's oldest cafe, open since 1733.
chill.bonus: Drink your cappuccino standing at the bar like a Florentine.

chill.title: Officina Profumo-Farmaceutica di Santa Maria Novella
chill.description: Browse frescoed halls of one of the world's oldest pharmacies, selling monk-formula perfumes since 1612.
chill.bonus: Smell the Acqua di Santa Maria Novella and pick a scent blind.

chill.title: Glasshouse Picnic at Giardino dell'Orticoltura
chill.description: Picnic on the lawn in front of a 19th-century iron-and-glass tepidarium that locals forget to tell you about.
chill.bonus: Find the dragon-shaped mosaic serpent in the upper garden.

chill.title: Wisteria Tunnel at Giardino Bardini
chill.description: Stroll the terraced Bardini Garden and its wisteria pergola with a direct view of the Duomo.
chill.bonus: Get one photo with the dome framed in the pergola.

chill.title: Afternoon in the Boboli Gardens
chill.description: Wander the Medici family's terraced Renaissance garden behind Palazzo Pitti.
chill.bonus: Find the Bacchus fountain and recreate the dwarf's pose.

chill.title: Sunset at the Giardino delle Rose
chill.description: Lounge among 350 rose varieties and Folon sculptures just below Piazzale Michelangelo.
chill.bonus: Find the Japanese garden corner and sit there for ten silent minutes.

8ball.title: Treasure Hunt at the Ciompi Flea Market
8ball.description: Dig through vintage oddities in the loggia stalls of Piazza dei Ciompi and buy something you didn't know existed.
8ball.bonus: Spend exactly 10 euros on the strangest thing you can find.

8ball.title: Rub Il Porcellino's Snout at Mercato Nuovo
8ball.description: Rub the bronze boar's shiny snout for a guaranteed return to Florence, then follow whatever street looks most interesting.
8ball.bonus: Drop a coin from the boar's mouth so it falls through the grate, for luck.

culture.title: Roman Theatre at Fiesole
culture.description: Sit in a 1st-century BC Roman theatre in the hills above Florence, still used for summer concerts.
culture.bonus: Sit in the top row and whisper to a friend on stage to test the acoustics.

culture.title: Masaccio Frescoes at the Brancacci Chapel
culture.description: Study the frescoes that kick-started the Renaissance in a tiny chapel in Santa Maria del Carmine.
culture.bonus: Spot the self-portrait Masaccio slipped into the scene.

culture.title: Michelangelo's David at the Galleria dell'Accademia
culture.description: Stand beneath the original David at the end of a hall lined with Michelangelo's unfinished Prisoners.
culture.bonus: Walk all the way around David and find the view of his eyes from the left.

culture.title: Basilica di Santa Croce
culture.description: Pay respects at the tombs of Michelangelo, Galileo and Machiavelli in Florence's grand Franciscan basilica.
culture.bonus: Find the tombs of Michelangelo, Galileo and Machiavelli and pay respects to each.

culture.title: Uffizi Gallery
culture.description: See Botticelli, Leonardo and Caravaggio in the Medici's original gallery on the Arno.
culture.bonus: Find Botticelli's Venus and spot the one detail nobody photographs.

culture.title: Bargello Museum
culture.description: See Donatello's bronze David and Michelangelo's Bacchus in Florence's medieval prison turned sculpture museum.
culture.bonus: Compare Donatello's and Verrocchio's Davids side by side.

culture.title: Walk the Vasari Corridor
culture.description: Cross the river on the Medici's private elevated passageway from the Uffizi over Ponte Vecchio to Palazzo Pitti.
culture.bonus: Look through the window over Ponte Vecchio where Medici once spied on the crowds below.

culture.title: Museo Galileo
culture.description: Gawk at Galileo's own telescopes and Medici scientific instruments beside the Arno.

foodie.title: Dinner at Trattoria Cammillo
foodie.description: Book a table at the old-school Oltrarno trattoria for fried artichokes and handmade pasta in a buzzing room.
foodie.bonus: Phone in your reservation in Italian, no apps.

foodie.title: Butcher's Feast at Antica Macelleria Cecchini
foodie.description: Feast at Dario Cecchini's communal tables in Panzano after a welcome of Chianti butter and wine at the famous butcher counter.
foodie.bonus: Accept Dario's lard on bread and a glass of red at the counter before you sit.

foodie.title: Gelato at Vivoli
foodie.description: Grab a cup of gelato at Florence's oldest gelateria, scooping near Santa Croce since 1930.
foodie.bonus: Order the Gran Crema affogato from the new bar next door.

foodie.title: Schiacciata at All'Antico Vinaio
foodie.description: Grab a hot, oversized schiacciata sandwich from the Via dei Neri shop that started Florence's sandwich craze.
foodie.bonus: Order the La Favolosa without looking at the menu board.

foodie.title: Award-Winning Gelato at Gelateria Dondoli
foodie.description: Taste champion gelato on Piazza della Cisterna from master Sergio Dondoli, scooping there since 1992.
foodie.bonus: Order the Vernaccia sorbet and eat it on the cistern steps.

foodie.title: Bistecca at Buca Mario
foodie.description: Share a lava-stone bistecca alla fiorentina in a 16th-century cellar dining room open since 1886.
foodie.bonus: Ask the waiter to tell the story of the cellar and order it rare, no exceptions.

foodie.title: Lunch at Trattoria Mario
foodie.description: Squeeze into a shared table at the 1953 market trattoria for ribollita and rare bistecca at lunch only.
foodie.bonus: Share your table with strangers and swap one bite of whatever they ordered.

foodie.title: Butter Chicken at Trattoria Sostanza
foodie.description: Eat the legendary pan-seared butter chicken at a narrow trattoria serving the same menu since 1869.
foodie.bonus: Order the meringue cake for the table without asking anyone.

foodie.title: Communal Dinner at Il Latini
foodie.description: Join the communal tables under hanging hams for ribollita and steak at a Bib Gourmand trattoria.
foodie.bonus: Let the waiter choose your whole meal.

foodie.title: Panforte at Pasticceria Nannini
foodie.description: Stand at the bar of Siena's historic pastry house for panforte, ricciarelli and an espresso.
foodie.bonus: Buy a box of ricciarelli and give one to a stranger in the Campo.

foodie.title: Lampredotto at Da Nerbone
foodie.description: Brave Florence's tripe sandwich at the market stall that has served it since 1872.
foodie.bonus: Say 'bagnato' with both sauces like a local.

foodie.title: Lunch at Trattoria Cibreo
foodie.description: Eat Fabio Picchi's no-pasta Florentine menu at the small Sant'Ambrogio trattoria sibling of Cibreo.
foodie.bonus: Order the dish you can't pronounce.

adventure.title: Climb the Leaning Tower of Pisa
adventure.description: Spiral up 251 tilted steps inside the world's most famous structural mistake.
adventure.bonus: Feel the lean on the spiral stairs, then do the push-the-tower photo but facing the wrong way.

adventure.title: Cycle the Arno Through Parco delle Cascine
adventure.description: Pedal Florence's biggest park along the river on the city's cycle path, from the centre to the Indiano bridge.
adventure.bonus: Ride to the Indiano monument at the far tip of the park where the Mugnone meets the Arno.

adventure.title: Climb Giotto's Bell Tower
adventure.description: Climb 414 steps up Giotto's marble campanile for an eye-level stare at Brunelleschi's dome.
adventure.bonus: Spot your next climb, the Dome, from the top terrace and photograph it framed by the bell tower grille.

adventure.title: Cycle the Lucca City Walls
adventure.description: Rent a bike and loop the tree-lined top of Lucca's perfectly intact Renaissance ramparts.
adventure.bonus: Do a full 4.2 km lap without stopping, then do a second lap in the other direction.

adventure.title: Climb the Torre del Mangia
adventure.description: Climb 400 narrow steps up Siena's 14th-century civic tower above the Piazza del Campo.
adventure.bonus: Look straight down onto the shell of Piazza del Campo and spot where the Palio horses turn.

adventure.title: Rocca di Montestaffoli Fortress Lookout
adventure.description: Scramble up the ruined 14th-century fortress in San Gimignano for a free sunset view over the vineyards.
adventure.bonus: Climb the little lookout turret and catch the towers turning gold at sunset.

adventure.title: Hike Monte Ceceri Above Fiesole
adventure.description: Trail through pine woods and old sandstone quarries to the hill where Leonardo's flight experiment took off.
adventure.bonus: Find the plaque where Leonardo da Vinci tested his flying machine and strike a launch pose.

adventure.title: Climb Lucca's Torre delle Ore
adventure.description: Climb 207 wooden steps past the working 18th-century clock mechanism in Lucca's tallest tower.
adventure.bonus: Be under the bell when it strikes the hour.

adventure.title: Sunrise Climb up the Rampe del Poggi to Piazzale Michelangelo
adventure.description: Walk the grotto-lined Poggi ramps from the Arno to Florence's most famous panorama before the crowds wake up.
adventure.bonus: Get there before the sun clears the hills and time-lapse the Duomo lighting up.

adventure.title: Climb the Torre di Arnolfo at Palazzo Vecchio
adventure.description: Climb the crenellated tower of Palazzo Vecchio for a bird's-eye look at Piazza della Signoria.
adventure.bonus: Find the tiny cell where Savonarola was held before his execution.

adventure.title: Climb Torre Grossa in San Gimignano
adventure.description: Climb the tallest of San Gimignano's medieval towers for a 360 view over the Tuscan hills.
adventure.bonus: Count the surviving towers of San Gimignano from the top.

adventure.title: Porta del Cielo Rooftop Tour of Siena Cathedral
adventure.description: Walk the hidden roof passages of Siena's Duomo on the guided Gate of Heaven tour.
adventure.bonus: Look down through the interior windows onto the marble floor mosaics far below.

adventure.title: Climb Brunelleschi's Dome
adventure.description: Squeeze through the 463-step passage between the two shells of the Duomo's dome for the best view in Florence.
adventure.bonus: Count the 463 steps out loud and toast the top with a selfie under the frescoes.

adventure.title: Climb Torre Guinigi and Its Rooftop Oaks
adventure.description: Climb a medieval tower in Lucca that has holm oak trees growing on its roof.
adventure.bonus: Pick out the oval of Piazza dell'Anfiteatro from above and snap it.

adventure.title: Hike up Costa San Giorgio to Forte di Belvedere
adventure.description: Hike the steep medieval lane from Ponte Vecchio to the Medici star fort high above the city.
adventure.bonus: Continue down Via di San Leonardo between the olive-grove walls without checking your phone.

adventure.title: Walk the Pisa City Walls
adventure.description: Walk the restored 12th-century walkway on top of Pisa's medieval walls, looking down on the Field of Miracles.
adventure.bonus: Walk the stretch that looks down on Piazza dei Miracoli and grab an aerial-style photo of the tower.
